messages.snippet: Dear all, Our document management system (iManage) will be unavailable from 20:00 on Saturday 18 Apr
messages.subject: Planned DMS maintenance - Saturday 18 April
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

Our document management system (iManage) will be unavailable from 20:00 on Saturday 18 April until 02:00 Sunday for scheduled maintenance. Please save and close all documents beforehand. Email will be unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk
